=={{header|ghul}}==

<syntaxhighlight lang="ghul">
use IO.Std.write_line;
use Ghul.Pipes;

reverse(s: string) -> string =>
    s |> reduce("", (acc, c) => "{c}{acc}");

is_palindrome(s: string) -> bool => s =~ reverse(s);

// Ignores non-letters and folds case, so a phrase with spaces and punctuation reads as a
// palindrome when its letters do.
is_inexact_palindrome(s: string) -> bool =>
    s 
        |> filter(c => c |> char.is_letter())
        |> map(c => c |> char.to_lower())
        |> reduce("", (acc, c) => "{acc}{c}")
        |> is_palindrome();

write_line("is_palindrome(\"racecar\"): {is_palindrome("racecar")}");
write_line("is_palindrome(\"hello\"): {is_palindrome("hello")}");
write_line("is_palindrome(\"rotor\"): {is_palindrome("rotor")}");

write_line("is_inexact_palindrome(\"A man, a plan, a canal: Panama\"): {is_inexact_palindrome("A man, a plan, a canal: Panama")}");
write_line("is_inexact_palindrome(\"race car\"): {is_inexact_palindrome("race car")}");
write_line("is_inexact_palindrome(\"hello world\"): {is_inexact_palindrome("hello world")}");
</syntaxhighlight>

{{out}}
<pre>
is_palindrome("racecar"): True
is_palindrome("hello"): False
is_palindrome("rotor"): True
is_inexact_palindrome("A man, a plan, a canal: Panama"): True
is_inexact_palindrome("race car"): True
is_inexact_palindrome("hello world"): False
</pre>
